title: OperationResultV2
description: Bridge reply to a contract-2 OperationRequest. Unlike contract 1, idempotency_key is required on every reply (failure F1). `unknown` means the outcome could not be proven: resolve it through bridge.get_operation_status or a state read before any retry — never resend blindly. `observed` reports a previously-unknown operation resolved from the journal without re-execution.

journal_state.description: Producer-side operation journal state at reply time (informational, but must agree with status: applied/observed ⇒ observed; queued ⇒ queued; unknown ⇒ unknown).
